# 74132 - Quadruple 2-input positive NAND Schmitt trigger

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74132.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74132.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 27 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74132 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74132.png) | ![74132 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74132.png) | ![74132 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74132.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 1 | 1A | input |  | Schmitt trigger input |
| 2 | 1B | input |  | Schmitt trigger input |
| 3 | 1Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 4 | 2A | input |  | Schmitt trigger input |
| 5 | 2B | input |  | Schmitt trigger input |
| 6 | 2Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | 3A | input |  | Schmitt trigger input |
| 10 | 3B | input |  | Schmitt trigger input |
| 8 | 3Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 12 | 4A | input |  | Schmitt trigger input |
| 13 | 4B | input |  | Schmitt trigger input |
| 11 | 4Y | output | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1Y = NOT(1A AND 1B) | Positive-logic NAND with Schmitt-trigger (hysteresis) inputs. |
| 6 | 2Y = NOT(2A AND 2B) | Positive-logic NAND with Schmitt-trigger (hysteresis) inputs. |
| 8 | 3Y = NOT(3A AND 3B) | Positive-logic NAND with Schmitt-trigger (hysteresis) inputs. |
| 11 | 4Y = NOT(4A AND 4B) | Positive-logic NAND with Schmitt-trigger (hysteresis) inputs. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | yes |
| vtPlusV | {'min': 1.5, 'typ': 1.7, 'max': 2.0} |
| vtMinusV | {'min': 0.6, 'typ': 0.9, 'max': 1.1} |
| hysteresisV | {'min': 0.4, 'typ': 0.8} |
| notes | Thresholds at VCC 5 V: VT+ 1.5 / 1.7 / 2.0 V (min/typ/max), VT- 0.6 / 0.9 / 1.1 V, hysteresis min 0.4 V, typ 0.8 V. IIL max -1.2 mA, IIH max 40 uA. IT+ typ -0.43 mA, IT- typ -0.56 mA. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 15 | 22 |
| any | Y | PHL | 15 | 22 |

## Notes

vtPlusV/vtMinusV/hysteresisV are extra fields in the electrical block for the Schmitt thresholds (FORMAT.md asks for VT+ and VT-).

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 6, Schmitt-trigger positive-NAND gates and inverters with totem-pole outputs, column '14, '132](http://www.bitsavers.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/06.pdf) - book pages 6-14, 6-15 (PDF pages 14, 15); SN74132
